augments.name: Looting Mk. 1
augments.description: Basic looting augment. More backpack slots and weight capacity, but low defensive and tactical capability.

augments.name: Combat Mk. 1
augments.description: Basic combat augment. Supports stronger shields, but with limited backpack capacity and Quick Use slots.

augments.name: Tactical Mk. 1
augments.description: Basic tactical augment. More Quick Use slots for more tactical choice, but limited survivability and slightly lower looting potential.

augments.name: Free Loadout Augment
augments.description: Basic augment for rookie Raiders, offering slightly more backpack space and carry capacity.

augments.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Survivor)
augments.description: A heavy-duty pack mule augment. Large weight capacity and large backpack space.
augments.ability_description: While downed and stationary, health regenerates up to 75% of max downed health.

augments.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Safekeeper)
augments.description: A looting augment that trades weight and utility for increased looting potential.
augments.ability_description: A Safe Pocket that allows any items to be stored.

augments.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Revival)
augments.description: A tactical augment focused on utility over defense and looting.
augments.ability_description: Restores 1 health every 5 seconds. When damage is taken, the effect is paused for 30 seconds.

augments.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Smoke)
augments.description: An upgraded version of the Tactical MK.2 augment, adding expanded capacity across the board.
augments.ability_description: Upon Shield break, deploys a small smoke grenade. Has a fixed cooldown.

augments.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Defensive)
augments.description: A defensive-focused augment for keeping Shields topped up.
augments.ability_description: Allows Shield Rechargers to be used while running.

augments.name: Combat Mk. 3 (Aggressive)
augments.description: An improved version of the Combat II augment. Supports more shield types, and comes with extra space for grenades.
augments.ability_description: Restores 2 health every 5 seconds. When damage is taken, the effect is paused for 30 seconds.

augments.name: Tactical Mk. 2
augments.description: Adds more backpack space and an extra utility item slot.
augments.ability_description: Upon Shield break, deploys a small smoke grenade. Has a fixed cooldown.

augments.name: Combat Mk. 2
augments.description: A Combat augment more focused on maneuverability than absorbing damage.
augments.ability_description: Restores 1 health every 5 seconds. When damage is taken, the effect is paused for 30 seconds.

augments.name: Looting Mk. 2
augments.description: Significantly increases looting potential; adds slots for trinkets.
augments.ability_description: Automatically throws off attached Ticks after 1s.

augments.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Cautious)
augments.description: A looting augment that swaps some carry capacity to increase survivability.
augments.ability_description: Upon Shield break, automatically administers a weak Adrenaline Shot. Has a fixed cooldown.

augments.name: Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking)
augments.description: A combat augment more focused on maneuverability than absorbing damage.
augments.ability_description: Stowed or unequipped Pistols and Hand Cannons are 33% faster to equip.

augments.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Healing)
augments.description: A healing-focused augment which adds extra slots for healing items.
augments.ability_description: When revived from being downed, releases a healing cloud that instantly restores 20 health. Has a 30-second cooldown.
